rows.translation_en:
First, please tell me your gender.
Are you a graceful Japanese maiden (female),
or a gallant Japanese lad (male)?
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Next, please enter your family name.
You'll only enter it once.
Please take care to spell it correctly.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Now for your given name.
A silly name, or someone else's name,
will spoil half the impact of the ending!
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
May I ask your date of birth, too?
You're not a pop idol,
so don't go lying about your age!
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Now for the last question.
I racked my rather limited brains
to come up with this one for people like these:
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
"I have no time, but I want to play games!"
Busy office workers, parents raising children,
students preparing for exams... All of you!
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
How much of your precious time
can you spare for this game?
Of course, you can change this later.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Is everything correct?
If you'd like to change anything,
move the cursor over it and let me know.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Child of the %@ bloodline, %$,
awaken.
There is something important I must tell you.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Fearing vengeance from the %@ clan,
Shutendoji placed two terrible curses
upon its blood.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
The first is the Curse of Short Life.
You will grow many times faster than
ordinary people and die within a few years.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.
review_notes: User requested natural English line breaks; all words and engine controls retained. Measured with the native VWF; last line reserves space for the advance icon.
Actual complete-message fit, native text provenance, frame/ink/icon coordinates: work/ui/dialogue-reflow-0.2.17/verification.json

rows.translation_en:
The other is the Curse of Barren Blood.
You cannot conceive children
with another mortal.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
These two curses
will never fade
unless you defeat Shutendoji.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Child of the %@ bloodline, %$!!
You have no time to despair.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
The last glimmer of hope
left to humankind
now lies in your blood alone...
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
There is only one path for you and for us.
You must leave children behind!!
Unite with us, the gods.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Then build your strength, little by little,
and one day strike down Shutendoji!!
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Restore peace and glory to the %@ clan,
and peace and prosperity to the mortal world,
through the power of your blood.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Now choose one of these four deities
to be the %s
of your first child.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.
Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.
Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.
Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Congratulations!! A lovely baby girl.
Now think of a name
that will suit this child.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Congratulations!! A healthy baby boy.
Your first duty as a parent
is to give this child a name.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.
Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Child of the %@ bloodline, %$!!
As you embark on your journey,
let me bestow a few gifts upon you.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
First, matching clothes.
Choose a color to represent
the %@ clan's strong bonds.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en: Is this the color you want?
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Next, equipment and scrolls.
These belonged to your parents.
Treasure these keepsakes and use them well.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
There are quite a few, so I will send them home.
You can look them over at your leisure.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
I shall send a girl named Itsuka
to watch over your home when you set out
and help with all the little chores.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
She can be a little unreliable,
but she is cheerful, energetic, and hardworking.
Keep her by your side for many years to come.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
One last thing.
When the %@ clan
strikes down Shutendoji...
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.
review_notes: Intentional source trailing fragment retained; sentence continues in 3:25.

rows.translation_en:
Child of the %@ bloodline, %$!!
You will return
to life in the mortal world!!
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Remember this,
and strive to bring that day
one step closer.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Estimated completion time: 20-30 hours
"I just don't have the energy for RPGs lately."
Yes!! This is the mode for you!!
Battles are simplified and events often skipped,
so relax and enjoy this condensed version.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Estimated completion time: 30-50 hours
"I'm busy and don't have much time,
but I still want the full RPG experience."
Leave it to us!! This mode
will do everything it can to deliver!
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Estimated completion time: 50-100 hours
"An RPG feels all the more rewarding
when you take the time to get absorbed in it."
Exactly!! This mode is sure
to leave you thoroughly satisfied!!
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Estimated completion time: 100+ hours
We deliberately recreated the balance
of RPGs from their 1980s beginnings.
Hardship, nostalgia, and tearful satisfaction.
The game designer's personal recommendation!!
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Who should teach %s?
Please choose
a teacher.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Unfortunately, the %@ clan has no one
who can train %s
at the moment.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
For %s's training,
%s%s will teach personally. Is that right?
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Leave %s's training to %s%s?
Is that your decision?
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
%s is preparing to set out.
If they teach %s,
you'll need to reorganize the party.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Relieve %s of party duty
and make teaching %s the priority?
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en: Don't forget to choose the party again.
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Cancel %s's training, and have %s
teach %s instead?
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.
Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
%s will study independently! %s
will teach %s, right?
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
%s was so
eager to get started...
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.

rows.translation_en:
Then I'll teach %s
"How to Stir a Rice-Bran Pickling Bed
the Right Way."
rows.context: Title/setup, clan history, or service menu as identified by the complete source table.
